notes.title: Update for Achievements!
notes.content:
[u][b]Achievements![/b][/u]

Hi all, we have seen your posts saying that the Achievements are not working correctly. The team have found the bug preventing them from updating correctly on Steam, and they are fixing. As soon as the build is tested, we will update the build and all your achievements should then register properly.

Thank you for your patience with us, This is our first game on Steam ever! 

Bless you all

Telltale Games UK
